text:
incident-bot: ALERT: production canary 'encoder-canary' reporting high restart rate and increased 5xxs. PagerDuty triggered: PD-9912. Investigating.

alex: Just saw the deploy that rolled ~10% traffic to encoder-canary. Crashloops started immediately. Logs show readiness probe failing (GET /health -> 500). Suspect env var mismatch.

eng-runner: Confirmed. The deployed manifest replaced MODEL_PATH with MODEL_DIR (typo) in the container env. App expects MODEL_PATH. Container starts but readiness fails, HPA sees 0 ready pods -> scales down then back up aggressively.

maria: Also saw node-drain job running on a subset of nodes during the rollout which led to pods being rescheduled onto already-busy nodes. Combined with aggressive HPA behavior, we got oom/restart churn on the canary set.

product-ops: Flipping feature flag to divert traffic off the canary now :white_check_mark:. Routing back to stable.

support-liaison: Support: small number of customers on A/B routing hit 502s for ~7m. Opened status update on status.redwood.ai with link. Notified two affected enterprise contacts.

sre-jordan: Taking ownership (on-call). Immediate plan: 1) Pause rollout / hold any new deploys 2) Roll back encoder deployment to previous revision 3) Patch manifest typo and HPA minReplicas 4) Cordon affected nodes until stabilised. Executing now.

eng-runner: Commands run: 
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/encoder -n production
kubectl set env deployment/encoder MODEL_PATH=/models/v1 -n production
kubectl patch hpa encoder-hpa -n production --type merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":1}}'
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-8-23
```

eng-runner: Rolled back to revision 42. New pods for stable are coming up and passing readiness checks. HPA minReplicas set to 1.

incident-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED -> traffic diverted, rollback completed. Monitoring window 30m.

alex: Filed infra issue #1234 to add a CI lint that catches renamed env vars and enforce manifest schema. Also adding a pre-deploy canary smoke test to ensure readiness endpoint returns 200.

product-ops: We'll coordinate postmortem and update the feature-flag playbook to include quicker kill-switch routing for canaries.

pagerduty: PD-9912: incident acknowledged -> resolved. Escalation cleared.

sre-jordan: Leaving follow-up checklist here: 1) enforce manifest schema in CI 2) add canary readiness smoke test 3) review HPA scale thresholds for low-traffic canaries 4) run node-drain simulation in staging. I'll draft the postmortem and tag the owners. Closing thread if stable in 30m. :eyes:
